newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania plans incentives for domestic investors.
newsitem.headline: Romania plans incentives for domestic investors.

text.p: Romania's Senate will start debates next week on legislation that will aim to put local and foreign investors on an equal footing and boost the local capital market, a Senate official said on Wednesday.

"The bill, drafted by the government's Reform Council and the Senate's economic commision, will be discussed in emergency procedures next week," Viorel Catarama, head of the upper house's economic commision, told a news conference.

Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu said the bill, which follows recent rules on foreign investments, would put local and foreign investors on an equal footing and aim also to stimulate the growth of small and medium-sized enterprises.
The new bill will apply to all Romanian companies with majority private capital as well as to joint ventures in which foreign participation is the equivalent of up to $350,000.
Under the bill, facilities granted to domestic investors would include tax exemption on reinvested profit, and 50 percent cuts in custom duties for imports of raw materials and spare parts.
It also exempts from custom duties machinery and industrial equipment imports and, depending on the size and area of investment, cuts the tax on profits to 25 percent from the present 38 percent.

Investments exceeding 25 billion lei ($3.5 million) would benefit from extra facilities, including ceilings of 15 percent tax on gross profit extended for up to 10 years of activity, and 50 percent cuts in value added tax (VAT) -- now levied at a single 18 percent for most products.
According to the draft law local investment companies as well as pension and social insurance funds will be exempt from profit tax, while securities firms will be VAT exempt.

It also envisages incentives for small and medium-sized companies, such as profit tax in a range of five to 15 percent for five years of activity and a five percent cut in taxes on wages owed to the state budget.
